evidence.snippet: In addition we introduce eMEM-Bench v1, a benchmark we construct over ProcTHOR-10K scenes for embodied memory evaluation.

claire_radar.motivation: We present eMEM (Embodied Memory), a hybrid graph-based memory system for embodied agents operating in physical environments.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing agent memory benchmarks lack diagnostic depth. eMEM-Bench provides interpretable results tied to memory-systems literature, allowing fine-grained comparison of embodied memory architectures beyond surface-task accuracy.
